WITH joined AS (
    SELECT L.ID, P.SEX, L.PT, L.IGA, L.IGM
    FROM Laboratory L
    INNER JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
),
group_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        ID, 
        SEX, 
        AVG(PT) as group_avg_pt,
        AVG(IGA - IGM) as group_avg_ig_diff
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY ID, SEX
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(group_avg_ig_diff) as overall_avg_ig_diff
    FROM group_avgs
),
with_ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        g.ID,
        g.SEX,
        g.group_avg_pt,
        g.group_avg_ig_diff,
        CASE 
            WHEN o.overall_avg_ig_diff IS NOT NULL 
            THEN g.group_avg_ig_diff / o.overall_avg_ig_diff 
            ELSE NULL 
        END as ratio
    FROM group_avgs g
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
    WHERE o.overall_avg_ig_diff IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(group_avg_pt) as avg_group_pt,
    AVG(group_avg_ig_diff) as avg_group_ig_diff,
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
FROM with_ratios
GROUP BY SEX
